## D — Signals, roundabouts, railroads and markings
Each knowledge sentence carries one physical-page anchor and one fact identifier. The author completed a separate source-fidelity pass before submission; independent coverage and hallucination QA remain pending.
Scope exclusions and source issues: Read physical pages forty through forty-five as ordinary signal, roundabout, railroad and marking guidance. Signal-head and lane-diagram illustrations are carried only through the extracted text descriptions; no numeric value beyond the stated limits is asserted.
Dynamic disposition: Posted reversible-lane signals, reserved-lane schedules and local lane reservations vary by time and place; only the displayed control governs.
Text-only extraction cannot establish the meaning of an unreadable diagram. Any such material is withheld until a page-specific visual observation is recorded.
